title: Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2609.34924v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Rules for AI self-improvement often key on the model itself: has it been retrained, or are its weights frozen? We argue that, for AI coding agents, this check is incomplete, and we propose, but do not run, the experiment that would test it. An agent that keeps revising its own work runs into diminishing returns as long as the set of changes it can reach stays fixed, and can escape them only if that set grows. Our hypothesis is that the set can grow with the model untouched, because the software around the model, its scaffold of tools, tests and task breakdown, can be rewritten. If so, a frozen model guarantees a ceiling eventually but not steady behavior on the way there, and audits should track changes to the scaffold, not only to the model. The same criterion separates three things often lumped together: more search within a fixed setup, retraining the model during use (which can raise the ceiling), and rewriting the scaffold

translated_title: 审计脚手架，而非检查点：智能体编程中递归自我改进的平稳性二分法
translated_abstract: AI自我改进的规则通常以模型本身为准：它是否被重新训练过，或者其权重是否被冻结？我们认为，对于AI编程智能体而言，这一检查是不完整的，并且我们提出了（但并未实际运行）能够检验这一观点的实验。一个不断修改自身工作的智能体，只要其所能触及的变更集合保持固定，就会遭遇收益递减；只有当该集合扩大时，才能摆脱这一困境。我们的假设是，即使模型保持不变，这个集合也可以扩大，因为模型周围的软件——即由工具、测试和任务分解构成的脚手架——是可以被重写的。如果这一假设成立，那么冻结的模型最终会保证存在一个上限，但在达到上限的过程中并不能保证行为的平稳性，因此审计应该跟踪脚手架的变化，而不仅仅是模型的变化。同样的判据还能区分通常被混为一谈的三件事：在固定设置内进行更多搜索、在使用过程中重新训练模型（这可能提高上限），以及重写脚手架。
tldr: 该论文提出，评估AI编程智能体的自我改进不应只关注模型检查点，而应审计其脚手架（工具、测试和任务分解），并假设即使模型冻结，重写脚手架也能扩大可达变更集合，从而突破收益递减的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that auditing the scaffold (tools, tests, and task breakdown) of AI coding agents matters more than checking model checkpoints, hypothesizing that even a frozen model can escape diminishing returns by rewriting its scaffold to expand the set of reachable changes.
